title: OverSire runbooks
description: A runbook takes one item from plan to merge in a fixed list of steps. Each step is a fresh agent session. The daemon of the sessions machine runs the steps in order (/v1/runbook-runs). The app keeps the runbooks in config.json. Dates are ISO 8601 UTC.

Review.description: The step is a review. Verdict gaps runs the fix step, then the review again, up to rounds more times. Verdict pass skips the fix step.

fix.description: A later step that is not a review. One fix step serves one review.

rounds.description: The fix rounds. 0: gaps pauses the run at once.

agent.description: An OverSire agent name of Settings › Agents, for example claude-max.

prompt.description: The first prompt of the session. Placeholders: {key} {url} {title} {item} {workspace} {project} {round} {notes} {group} {worktree} {done}. {group} is the worktree group of the item, .wt/<key>; {worktree} is the same.

pauseBefore.description: The run waits at a gate for your approval before the step starts.

Runbook.description: In config.json runtime.runbooks. A run keeps a full copy.

AgentLaunch.description: One agent, resolved by the app at the start. The fields go into LaunchRequest.

RunbookStart.description: The body of POST /v1/runbook-runs. HTTP 400: the runbook is not valid, with the problems. HTTP 409: the item has an open run.

runtime.description: The runtime of the daemon, for example orca. Absent: the first runtime that runs and has workspaces.

agents.description: Each agent that a step names.

startAt.description: The first step. The steps before it are skipped.

notes.description: Text for {notes} before the first note of a step.

RunState.description: gate: waits for your approval. paused: needs you (no verdict, blocked, round limit, or Pause).

StepState.description: pass and gaps: the verdict of a review. done and skipped: the verdict of another step. blocked: the agent cannot go on. ended: the session ended with no verdict. failed: the session did not start.

StepRun.description: One round of one step. Round 1 is the first run. A retry or a review round adds an entry.

daemonSession.description: The DaemonSession id of the session.

terminal.description: The terminal handle in the runtime.

note.description: The note of oversire step done.

RunbookRun.description: The answer of the /v1/runbook-runs routes, and the run of a runbookRun frame on the event stream.

reason.description: Why the run is paused or failed. User text.

current.description: The step that works, asks, or waits at the gate.

Verdict.description: pass and gaps for a review step, done and skipped for another step, blocked for all.

StepDone.description: The body of POST /v1/runbook-runs/{id}/steps/{step}/done. HTTP 409: the step is not current.

StepPatch.description: The body of PATCH /v1/runbook-runs/{id}/steps/{step}, only for a step that did not start (else HTTP 409). It changes the copy of the run.

launch.description: The resolved agent. Needed when agents of the run does not have the agent.
